import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Equiv.Basic

/-!
# Transition units between rank-one frames

Two trivializations of a free rank-one module differ by a unique unit. This
provides the algebraic input for independence of local differential orders
from the chosen frame.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v

namespace Hartshorne

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R]
variable {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]

private theorem frame_apply_eq_smul_one (e : R ≃ₗ[R] M) (a : R) :
    e a = a • e 1 := by
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using e.map_smul a (1 : R)

/-- Two frames of a rank-one module differ by a unique unit. -/
theorem existsUnique_unit_smul_frame (e e' : R ≃ₗ[R] M) :
    ∃! u : Rˣ, e' 1 = (u : R) • e 1 := by
  let a : R := e.symm (e' 1)
  let b : R := e'.symm (e 1)
  have ha : e' 1 = a • e 1 := by
    simpa only [a, e.apply_symm_apply] using frame_apply_eq_smul_one e a
  have hb : e 1 = b • e' 1 := by
    simpa only [b, e'.apply_symm_apply] using frame_apply_eq_smul_one e' b
  have hab : a * b = 1 := by
    apply e'.injective
    calc
      e' (a * b) = a • (b • e' 1) := by
        rw [frame_apply_eq_smul_one e', mul_smul]
      _ = a • e 1 := by rw [← hb]
      _ = e' 1 := ha.symm
  let u : Rˣ := ⟨a, b, hab, by rw [mul_comm, hab]⟩
  refine ⟨u, ha, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  apply Units.ext
  apply e.injective
  calc
    e (v : R) = (v : R) • e 1 := frame_apply_eq_smul_one e (v : R)
    _ = e' 1 := hv.symm
    _ = a • e 1 := ha
    _ = e a := (frame_apply_eq_smul_one e a).symm

/-- A single transition unit relates two frames at every scalar. -/
theorem exists_unit_smul_frame_apply (e e' : R ≃ₗ[R] M) :
    ∃ u : Rˣ, ∀ a : R, e' a = (u : R) • e a := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, -⟩ := existsUnique_unit_smul_frame e e'
  refine ⟨u, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [frame_apply_eq_smul_one e', frame_apply_eq_smul_one e, hu,
    smul_comm a (u : R)]

end Hartshorne
